Hildegard 0.1.13 is a pre-alpha. It lets claude.ai and ChatGPT reach your studio through your own HTTPS address, and it
lets you make the Studio look like yours.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update` (or `hildegard update all` for every device).

## Added

- **Your own front door.** `hildegard host --public-url https://studio.example.com` serves the link through an HTTPS
  address you run, such as a free Cloudflare named tunnel, instead of Tailscale Funnel. Add `<address>/mcp` to claude.ai
  or ChatGPT as a custom connector and sign in with your name and passphrase. The README has the tunnel setup. Keep
  the door one proxy hop from Hildegard, and keep the hosted port reachable only by your tunnel.
- **Themes.** Settings › This computer › Appearance has five themes (Hildegard, Vellum, Nocturne, Verdant, Silver),
  a custom accent color and dark, light or match-this-device. An accent that would be hard to read is adjusted, and
  the Studio says how.

## Fixed

- Start times on macOS read the same in every locale and time zone.
- ComfyUI stops with Hildegard, and the supervisor handles more edge cases on start and stop.
- Plugin packs refuse icon paths that would leave the pack, including Windows drive letters.
